market_specific_notes: Los Angeles shoppers often see broad same-day or next-day promises, but those only matter if the office explains the full process honestly.
In a bigger market, the practical edge comes from clearer workflow and fewer surprise follow-up steps.
local_vetting_points: Ask whether the office explains packet timing before taking payment.
Ask whether vaccines are onsite or referred out.
Ask what the clinic considers the normal turnaround when records are complete.
typical_cost_ranges: Use total-process comparison, not teaser pricing.
Ask what extra testing or vaccine gaps do to the final number.
payment_options: Confirm whether same-day or next-day booking changes the amount due upfront.
Ask which costs are fixed and which are conditional.
wait_time_notes: Packet timing can vary sharply when vaccine gaps or outside testing add another step.
availability_notes: Availability should be judged together with packet timing and office clarity.
named_resources_or_providers: Civil surgeon locator confirmation and clinic review screening for turnaround clarity.
city_intro_override: Los Angeles comparisons get clearer when you compare workflow, not branding: appointment speed, vaccine handling, add-on costs, and sealed-packet timing.

items: Compare full-process clarity, not just appointment speed.
